battle.name: 第九次敘利亞戰役
battle.brief: 前1445年，圖特摩斯三世發動第九次敘利亞遠征，回應卡特努、圖尼普與卡迭施在米坦尼支持下的集體叛變。大軍沿奧龍特斯河谷北進，在下游「水谷」夜襲聯軍營地，車兵趁亂突入中軍，擄獲卡特努王與其長子。埃及步兵中仍有一支專持月牙形青銅短劍的「斧手」隊，近身砍殺是破陣的關鍵。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 這是前十五世紀中葉埃及王權與西北亞諸邦在奧龍特斯河下游的一場正面決戰，也是圖特摩斯三世一連串敘利亞遠征中的第九次。開戰一方是埃及新王國第十八王朝：法老圖特摩斯三世親領的「王家大軍」是作戰中樞，旗下有「王之心」近衛師、阿穆克與西奈一線的守備部隊，以及來自努比亞的「米德賈伊」與「內姆提」等輕裝步兵與弓手隊伍；埃及方面的指揮高度集中，戰況由軍吏當場抄錄，凱旋後再以石碑形式立在卡爾納克與格貝爾巴卡爾。作戰另一方是西北亞諸邦組成的聯盟：以亞穆克平原的卡特努王為首腦，聯軍中還有奧龍特斯河中游的圖尼普、幼發拉底河上游的卡爾凱美什與卡迭施、北方的小亞細亞城邦以及阿拉布。米坦尼並未把主力擺上戰場，卻以使節、軍械與盟約從後方推動聯軍，並且不斷向北岸施加壓力。埃及官方文書把這批敵人一律稱為「九弓」，視為法老必須年年討伐的固定敵體；西北亞各城邦則多以「王」或「首領」自號，彼此之間維持著脆弱而互不信任的關係。
countriesEn: This was a set-piece clash between the Egyptian monarchy and a league of north-western Asian states on the lower Orontes in the mid fifteenth century BC, the ninth of Thutmose III's Syrian expeditions. On the Egyptian side stood the Eighteenth Dynasty New Kingdom: the royal army personally commanded by the pharaoh was the hinge of the whole effort, supported by the 'Heart of the King' bodyguard division, the garrison troops of Amurru and the Sinai, and Nubian contingents such as the Medjay and Nemty light infantry and archers. Egyptian command was highly centralised; army scribes copied the operations as they happened, and after the victory the reports were carved on stelae at Karnak and Gebel Barkal. The other side was a coalition of north-western Asian polities: headed by the king of Qatnu in the Amuq plain, it included Tunip on the middle Orontes, Karkemish and Kadesh on the upper Euphrates and Orontes, the small Anatolian states to the north, and Aleppo. Mitanni kept its main army out of the field but pushed the coalition from behind with emissaries, arms and alliance pacts, and never stopped pressing on the east bank. Egyptian official documents lumped all these enemies together as the 'Nine Bows', a fixed quarry to be harried every year; the Levantine city-states, for their part, each bore the title of 'king' or 'chief' and maintained a brittle mutual distrust.
people: 法老圖特摩斯三世是這場戰役最核心的人物。他登基之初只是少年國王，前若干年由太后攝政，成年之後便以年年出兵的節奏把埃及的邊界推向幼發拉底一線，本戰役正是這一政策的高潮之一；他的登基名「門克赫佩拉」一般釋為「真理的節制者」，荷魯斯名「卡納赫特·哈姆瓦塞特」意為「強牛在底比斯顯現」，埃及人稱他為「戰士之王」。指揮層面上，史料記載王太子阿蒙曾率領先鋒，在水谷的夜襲與正面衝鋒中扮演關鍵角色；軍中另有掌管文書與俘虜名錄的書吏，負責把戰果逐日帶回。敵方最關鍵的人物是卡特努王，他一人集聯盟兵權於一身，戰敗後與長子一同被埃及軍生擒，這位國王與其他被俘王子被押回埃及，後來成為阿蒙神廟浮雕與「九弓」儀式中的主角。米坦尼方面的王族阿塔舒馬拉在阿馬爾納書信中被提及曾捲入敘利亞的戰事並且遇害，其弟圖什拉塔繼位後致函埃及求援，這封信至今仍是外部學者還原聯盟內部運作最重要的旁證。
peopleEn: Pharaoh Thutmose III is the central figure of the campaign. He began his reign as a boy king under the regency of a queen mother; once he governed in his own right he campaigned year after year, pushing Egypt's frontier towards the Euphrates, and this battle was one of the climaxes of that policy. His prenomen, Menkheperre, is usually rendered as 'the controller of Maat', and his Horus name, Kanakht Khaemwaset, means 'the strong bull who appears in Thebes'; the Egyptians came to call him the great warrior. At the head of the formation the sources record that the crown prince Amun led the vanguard and played the decisive part in the night approach and in the assault that broke the enemy; army scribes elsewhere kept the register of prisoners and of the spoils. The most important figure on the opposing side was the king of Qatnu, who had concentrated the coalition's command in his own hands and who was taken alive together with his eldest son; that king and the other captive princes were dragged back to Egypt and later became part of the relief programmes and the 'Nine Bows' ritual in the temples. On the Mitanni side, the royal Artashumara is mentioned in the Amarna letters as having been drawn into the fighting in Syria and as having been killed, and his brother Tushratta, once king, wrote to Egypt asking for help; that letter remains the most important outside check on how the coalition was run.
kits: 卡面這件埃及月牙劍在這一戰役中屬於埃及步兵最靠前的近戰兵器，也是埃及軍與西北亞聯軍在裝備代差上的核心象徵。這種鐮刀形單刃短劍由銅或青銅打造，刃口內彎，砍入之後不必拔刀再揮，是埃及人從石器時代的鴨嘴斧一路演化下來的舊式冷兵器；圖特摩斯三世時期，埃及步兵之中仍設有專持月牙劍的「斧手」隊目，負責在弓兵與長矛兵之間撕開缺口時進行近身砍殺。不過同一時期，經西奈傳入的「阿凱亞式」直身雙刃銅劍已在埃及軍中出現，月牙劍正逐漸退居次要位置。戰役中埃及方面還配備：木製自弓與箭，箭鏃多為燧石或銅；長矛與投槍；蒙皮的白楊木大盾；銅斧與短匕首；輕型雙馬戰車，車輻六至八根、車廂窄小，僅供指揮與衝鋒；攻城用的木製塔架、斜坡與破城工具。遠征的後勤靠馱騾、驢隊與貯水陶罐維持，供應線自西奈的綠洲一路鋪到奧龍特斯河，埃及人自己也清楚，離開尼羅河流域的補給之後，這支大軍就沒有可能長久留在亞洲。
kitsEn: The Egyptian khopesh on this card is the front-line close-combat weapon of the Egyptian infantry and the clearest symbol of the equipment gap between Egypt and the north-western Asian coalition in this campaign. This sickle-shaped single-edged short sword was made of copper or bronze, its edge curving inward so that a blow could be delivered and the blade drawn back without having to be pulled free, and it was the direct descendant of the duckbill axes of Egypt's prehistory. In the reign of Thutmose III the Egyptian infantry still contained a corps of axe-men, the khopesh-bearers, whose task was to hack at close quarters once the archers and the spearmen had opened a gap in the enemy line. At the same time, however, the straight, double-edged 'Aegean-style' copper sword brought in through Sinai was already appearing in Egyptian hands, and the khopesh was gradually reduced to a secondary role. The rest of the Egyptian equipment in this campaign comprised wooden self-bows and arrows with flint or copper heads, spears and javelins, tall sycamore shields covered in leather, copper axes and short daggers, and light two-horse chariots with six to eight spokes and narrow bodies, carried by a driver and two crew, used for command and for the charge. For the sieges there were wooden towers, ramps and sapping tools. On campaign the rear was carried by mule and donkey trains together with water jars and food wagons, the supply line running from the oases of Sinai up the valley of the Orontes; the Egyptians knew well enough that once away from the Nile's flood, this army could not be kept in Asia for long.
tactics: 埃及人的戰術是一套以遠征補給為前提的標準動作：全軍以縱隊前進，最前是王太子率領的先鋒與一支受過特別訓練的突擊隊，中軍是法老的戰車與步兵大縱隊，殿後由守備部隊護住糧秣與攻城器械；行軍途中以三縱隊交替推拉，維持連續推進而不讓隊形散開，過夜則環形列陣、槍盾朝外、點起營火拒敵偷襲。進入水谷一帶，埃及軍利用山谷地形封鎖聯軍營地：先鋒入夜逼近，以弓兵壓制敵營外圍，拂曉發動衝鋒，聯軍陣腳一亂，車兵趁勢直插中軍，混戰中擄獲卡特努王與其長子。拿下聯盟樞紐之後，埃及軍再以圍城術逐個收拾仍拒絕歸順的城邑：先以弓手與投石手掩護，兵卒搭梯、掘壕、築斜坡逼近城牆，最後由工兵破壞牆基，配合火攻取城。整場戰役的節奏是速戰速決、不設長期據點：擊潰聯盟主力後立刻掃清奧龍特斯河兩岸，隨即沿原路退回埃及，全軍在入夏前離開敘利亞。
tacticsEn: Egyptian tactics in this campaign followed a standard sequence conditioned by the demands of expeditionary supply. The army marched in column, with the vanguard and a specially trained strike force under the crown prince in front, the pharaoh's chariot and the main body of infantry in the centre, and a rear guard covering the baggage and the siege equipment with its weapons turned outward. On the march the columns were relayed in three ranks so that the advance stayed continuous and the formation never lost cohesion; at night the camp was ringed with spears and shields facing outward and fires were kept burning to deter a surprise attack. In the Wadi al-Miyah the Egyptians used the valley itself to seal the coalition's camp: the vanguard closed in during the night, archers pinned the enemy perimeter, the assault went in at dawn, and when the coalition line broke the chariots drove straight into the centre, taking the king of Qatnu and his eldest son in the confusion that followed. Having taken the hinge of the coalition, the Egyptians reduced one recalcitrant city after another, Kadesh and Tunip among them: archers and slingers gave covering fire while the sappers dug in, built ramps and scaled the walls, and the base of the fortifications was finally broken by engineers working with fire. The rhythm of the whole campaign was speed and no winter quarters: once the coalition army was broken, the Egyptians swept both banks of the Orontes and then withdrew by the same road, leaving Syria before the summer was out.
data: 這場戰役可考的數字有限，但有幾組距離與編制可以交代：從卡爾納克出發，經西奈半島沿地中海海岸北上到奧龍特斯河下游，單程約六百公里上下；水谷戰場距今阿勒頗約一百二十公里，離地中海海岸約三十公里，距卡特努故城一帶不足二十公里。埃及軍的規模只能作量級描述：王室軍隊的步兵以萬人計，車隊以數百輛計，此外還有相當數量的馱載驢馬、貯水陶罐與糧食車隊隨行。聯軍方面，卡特努王帶來的車兵與弓兵在數量上被埃及官方描述為多於埃及軍，但具體數目並不可靠，兩軍的實際傷亡數字在現有史料中完全缺失，連戰俘總數也沒有留下。折算下來，聯軍車兵與埃及車隊的差距應在數倍之內，這正是聯盟無法與埃及正面對抗的關鍵。可確定的是，第九次敘利亞遠征是圖特摩斯三世至少十七次敘利亞遠征之一，戰役記錄分別見於卡爾納克編年殘段與格貝爾巴卡爾石碑，即史稱的「編年史補篇」，其年代在各種年表中分別落在前1445年前後與前1446年前後的範圍。
dataEn: Few figures for this campaign can be verified, but a few distances and orders of magnitude can be set out. From Karnak, through the Sinai and then north along the Mediterranean coast to the lower Orontes was roughly six hundred kilometres one way. The Wadi al-Miyah lay about a hundred and twenty kilometres from modern Aleppo, some thirty kilometres from the Mediterranean shore and less than twenty kilometres from the city of Qatnu, in the region of Tell Kazel. The size of the Egyptian force can only be given by order of magnitude: the infantry of the royal army numbered in the tens of thousands, the chariot parks in the hundreds, and a substantial train of pack donkeys, water jars and supply wagons travelled with them. On the coalition side, the chariots and bowmen brought by the king of Qatnu are described in the Egyptian text as more numerous than the Egyptian army, but the number itself is not reliable; no casualty figures survive in the sources for either side, and not even a total for the prisoners was recorded. Set against that, the gap between the coalition's chariots and the Egyptian chariot parks must have been a matter of several times, and that, more than anything else, was why the league could not stand and fight Egypt in the open. What can be stated with confidence is that the ninth Syrian campaign was one of at least seventeen Syrian expeditions of Thutmose III, recorded in the Karnak annalistic fragments and in the Gebel Barkal stele known as the 'Supplement to the Annals', and that the event is dated in the various chronologies to around 1445 or 1446 BC.
cause: 戰爭的起因是埃及在敘利亞的附庸體系崩解。上一次遠征，圖特摩斯三世曾越過幼發拉底河深入米坦尼邊境，把埃及的影響推到河東岸，卡特努、圖尼普、卡迭施等城邦表面上歸順，實際上只是退居待機。埃及在這些城邦駐有總督、書吏與稅吏，抽取穀物與貢賦；米坦尼則不斷以物資、婚盟與使節接觸奧龍特斯河兩岸，鼓勵它們脫離埃及。當埃及的駐軍被圍、書吏被逐出，聯軍在米坦尼的支援下同時起義，埃及的北翼與通往比布魯斯、黎巴嫩雪松林的商路隨時可能斷絕，這才是法老無法容忍的動因。從法老自己的敘事看，開戰的理由被歸結為「九弓」又一次集結挑戰；但從實際運作看，這是一場由附庸叛亂與宗主國安全利益共同驅動的邊境戰爭，圖特摩斯三世必須在聯盟完成整編之前把它打散，否則整個奧龍特斯河谷都會落入米坦尼的勢力範圍，埃及在近東的地位也將難以維持。
causeEn: The immediate occasion was the breakdown of the Egyptian system of vassalage in Syria. On the previous expedition Thutmose III had carried the war across the Euphrates to the borders of Mitanni and had driven Egyptian influence to the east bank of the river; Qatnu, Tunip and Kadesh had submitted on the surface but had in fact only gone into waiting. The Egyptians kept governors, scribes and tax collectors in these towns and drew grain and tribute from them, while Mitanni worked on the states along both banks of the Orontes with gifts, marriage ties and emissaries, urging them to leave Egypt. Once the Egyptian garrisons were shut up and the scribes driven out, and the client states rose together with Mitanni's backing, the northern flank of the empire and the trade road to Byblos and the cedar forests of Lebanon were in constant danger of being cut, and that was the danger the pharaoh could not tolerate. In the king's own narrative the outbreak is presented as the 'Nine Bows' rallying once more in challenge; in practice it was a frontier war driven both by the revolt of the vassals and by the security interests of the overlord. Thutmose III had to shatter the coalition before it could be fully organised, or the whole Orontes valley would have passed into Mitanni's sphere and Egypt's position in the Near East could not have been maintained.
impact: 這場戰役的直接後果，是埃及在奧龍特斯河下游的門戶重新被打開。卡特努王與王子被押回埃及，聯盟首腦被除，其餘城邦在失去外援後陸續回到埃及的附庸體系，埃及得以在亞穆克平原重新設防，把稅吏與駐軍派回卡迭施與圖尼普；被俘的王子後來被安插在卡爾納克阿蒙神廟的浮雕與祭祀場面之中，成為「九弓」意象的一部分。戰役同時向西北亞傳出一個明確訊號：只要聯軍集中一次，就會被埃及的車兵與弓兵正面粉碎，這直接影響了後來阿馬爾納書信中米坦尼求援的外交基調。從更長的歷史看，第九次敘利亞遠征延續了圖特摩斯三世「以連續遠征換取邊界穩定」的治國模式，埃及在近東的霸權因此再延續了數十年，直到阿門霍特普四世時代才開始鬆動；而在軍事技術上，銅與青銅武器的壓倒性優勢、輕型雙馬戰車的快速機動，以及以「水谷」為例的伏擊與追擊式戰法，也成為此後埃及在亞洲作戰的常規套路。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the battle was that Egypt's door into the lower Orontes was forced open once more. The king of Qatnu and his son were dragged back to Egypt, the head of the coalition was removed, and the remaining states, deprived of outside support, slipped back into the Egyptian orbit one after another; Egypt was able to re-garrison the Amuq plain and send its tax collectors and officials back to Kadesh and Tunip. The captive princes were later installed in the relief and ritual programme of the temple of Amun at Karnak as part of the imagery of the 'Nine Bows'. The campaign also sent a clear message to north-western Asia: a coalition assembled once would be broken head-on by the Egyptian chariots and archers, and this shaped the diplomatic tone of the later Mitanni requests for aid preserved in the Amarna letters. In the longer run the ninth Syrian campaign prolonged Thutmose III's mode of government, which bought the stability of the frontier with a series of consecutive expeditions, and Egyptian power in the Near East was sustained for several further decades, only beginning to loosen in the reign of Amenhotep IV. On the technical side the decisive superiority of copper and bronze weapons, the mobility of the light two-horse chariot, and the style of fighting exemplified at the Wadi al-Miyah, the ambush and the pursuit, also became regular elements of Egyptian campaigning in Asia.
result: 結果是埃及的完全勝利。聯軍主力在奧龍特斯河下游的「水谷」被擊潰，卡特努王與其長子被生擒，北亞各邦的首領或逃或降，卡迭施與圖尼普等拒降城市隨後被逐一攻破，聯盟在沒有米坦尼主力介入的情況下先行瓦解。埃及軍帶著大批俘虜、馬匹、車輛與繳獲的物資沿奧龍特斯谷地退回埃及，圖特摩斯三世回到底比斯後把這次戰役刻進卡爾納克的編年與格貝爾巴卡爾石碑，並在神廟的浮雕裡重新描繪「九弓」被制服的場面。對埃及而言，這一役並未把邊界推到幼發拉底河，卻保住了亞穆克這扇通往敘利亞的門，讓後來兩次敘利亞遠征得以在本土之後再發；對西北亞而言，聯盟式的集體反抗被證明無法與米坦尼的遠端支援配合，兩地的聯盟關係也因此更形緊密，而埃及對奧龍特斯河谷的控制則又延續了數十年。
resultEn: The result was a complete Egyptian victory. The main body of the coalition was broken in the Wadi al-Miyah on the lower Orontes, the king of Qatnu and his eldest son were taken alive, the chiefs of the northern states either fled or surrendered, and the rebel cities that still held out, Kadesh and Tunip among them, were reduced one by one; the league came apart before Mitanni could bring its main force into play. The Egyptians returned down the Orontes with a large haul of prisoners, horses, chariots and captured goods, and once back in Thebes Thutmose III had the campaign carved into the Karnak annals and the Gebel Barkal stele, while the temple reliefs re-enacted the defeat of the 'Nine Bows'. For Egypt the battle did not carry the frontier to the Euphrates, but it kept the Amuq gateway to Syria open, so that the two Syrian campaigns that followed could be launched from Egypt in their own season. For north-western Asia, coalition-style collective resistance was shown to be unworkable without close coordination with Mitanni, and the ties between the two were drawn tighter in consequence, while Egypt's control of the Orontes valley was extended once more for several more decades.
